title: Conjectures of Bernstein and Erd\H os for weighted Lagrange interpolation on the halfline with exponential weights
summary: Let I=[a,b] and consider the degree n Lagrange interpolation at the nodes x, where x\in S:={x=(x_0,x_1,...,x_n):a=x_0 m_j(x). The conjectures were proved by Kilgore and de Boor--Pinkus in 1978. Since then, analogous results were obtained only for a few cases when interpolation is made to certain very special spaces of polynomials, or when we apply weighted interpolation with rather special weights.
